pages.title: A Totem for the Weather
pages.text: Choose a totem for its particular trigger and threat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Freezing protects from freeze and supports frost attacks; Seething enhances nearby burning damage; Repulsion produces an attack-triggered wind response. Hold it offhand under its own condition.
